audit.summary: One Major defect in the polynomial affine-domain definition used by the explicit two-pole derivation; seven bounded Minor corrections. Valid local BVP/Fourier computations and core eigenvalue expansion are not refuted.
limitations: Explicit scalar angle branch jumps outside the asserted crack domain — Counterevidence: exp(iTheta) does not jump there and retains the required magnetic derivative. The cross is connected, so there is no claimed period obstruction isolating one pair.
Zero vanishing order omitted from sine profile — Counterevidence: Later estimates explicitly treat m=0; nonvanishing case is not excluded. Theorems2.6/2.7 explicitly assume u0(0)=0.
Global gradient bound exceeds domain hypotheses — Counterevidence: Only an interior neighbourhood of collision is needed. This even-case example is not claimed to separately disprove odd-case(3.12).
Half-line quadratic minimum uses whole-line value — Counterevidence: Outer direction set contains both w and-w. Thus final supremum formula(6.11) is unchanged.

Whole-plane tests invalid at fixed rescaling parameter — Counterevidence: Every fixed compact test is valid for sufficiently small epsilon. Limit first, then density; energy test with eta support has correct outer trace.

Polynomial comparison violates zero-outer-trace affine constraint — Counterevidence: Differential problem(7.2) imposes h only on crack and is wellposed; independently solved Fourier problem uses that consistent formulation.
Ordinary Fourier coefficients called orthonormal coefficients — Counterevidence: (7.14),(7.15) use correct ordinary coefficients and pi/2,pi weights.

Arbitrary complex eigenfunction phase is not bound to fixed real profile — Counterevidence: Remark3.5 andSection4 strongly suggest intended compatible real-phase convention; p34 redefinesv0 but relative alignment alone doesnot force itreal.
Limitations: Only frozen arXiv2306.05008v2 reviewed; uninspected subscription journal version not presumed identical.
Limitations: No full independent reproof of cited spectral continuity or electromagnetic local-expansion papers; assumptions and internal use checked.
Limitations: Bounded search found no separate supplement/code, not proof of global absence; no-code is not a defect.
Limitations: No numerical PDE or author code executed; own rational computations corroborate analytic proofs.

Limitations: At the initial-review stage, bounded native AI checks did not constitute independent acceptance. The current focused independent acceptance is recorded separately. No human review or independently attested backend identity is claimed.
Limitations: No next leading exponent claimed when odd-case leading coefficient vanishes.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

repair.content:
Use circle-valued gauge/local derivatives, or a corrected real branch differing by2pi constants.

Separate m=0 constant times gauge-sign profile; sine parameterization only m>=1.

Restrict to a fixed disk around0 or add justified boundary assumptions for a global claim.

Allow t inR, or keep one-sided formula and optimize signs afterwards.

Extend outside Omega/epsilon (not Omega), restrict fixed-epsilon tests to scaled domain, apply density only after limit.

Replace Pm,Tm by common compact cutoff equal1nearcrack, or impose only T(V-Pm)=0 oncrack; use domains containing relevant crack. Same cutoff preserves sandwich andTaylor errors.

Describe ordinary cosine/sine coefficients, or rescale consistently.

Explicitly fix u0=e^{iTheta0}v0 for previously fixed realv0, or complexify and transform both profiles bysamephase.
